study.question: Does coupling adjacent cross-action identity to relative elapsed time improve validation beyond equal-weight ordered activity and the incumbent, after controlling for the gap-weight marginal and arrow direction?
study.hypothesis: Observed: r0032-activity_ordered AUC .6207678359661487 versus activity_exchangeable .6206693467195261, but both below incumbent r0027-latest_endpoint .6208079251798616; target_ordered .6206557208873072 versus target_exchangeable .6206970410375715 gives the opposite ordering. These are adaptive single-seed observations, not significance. First512 candidate diagnostics show common411/1024 field coordinates, activity groups mean103.7393 versus target5.2695, and only165 common target-multiaction coordinates. Source inspection shows all adjacent activity transitions have equal weight; the inherited model has event ages/decay but no explicit action-pair/inter-group-duration coupling. Hypothesis: bursts and long interruptions contain different cross-action associations that equal-weight aggregation obscures. Whether relevant gap heterogeneity exists is unmeasured; registered diagnostics can falsify it. Preserve the stronger activity representation while testing gap alignment and direction, without selecting a time threshold.

Added deterministic duration/action-pair summaries are not a DIN reproduction. study.proposed_difference: For field-valid activity, group equal raw ages and use four-action fractions p_g, newest-first. K valid groups give N=K-1 adjacent pairs. Strict gaps d_i=age_(i+1)-age_i>0, mean gap m=sum(d)/N. Define w_i=m/(m+d_i), zero for absent pairs. This scale-free local-duration weight has no learned parameter, tuned horizon or absolute-time threshold; it rewards gaps short relative to the same prefix. Let M=sum p_old outer p_new/N, W=sum w_i p_old outer p_new/N and wbar=sum w_i/N. Aligned/directed uses W; factorized/directed uses wbar*M, the exact expectation of independently permuting the observed gap weights across fixed transition positions. Symmetric cells average the chosen matrix with its transpose. Every cell retains unweighted ordered parent M, computes all four options and appends0.5 times the 12 off-diagonal values per field through identical zero-initialized columns. Common support is exactly the parent target>=2 timestamp support, including equal-gap cases; no outcome-driven exclusion. Factorized control fixes the observed weight multiset in its permutation null and preserves its mean and all unweighted directed pairs in the readout, removing only gap-to-pair association. This dimensionless weighting measures relative gap heterogeneity, not absolute temporal density. Symmetric control preserves weighted unordered pair mass, removing only added arrow information. This is a discriminating follow-up of a promising but unsuccessful activity branch, not a new claimed state of the art.
predictions: Source/algebra: w in[0,1], sum16 W=wbar and sum16 factorized=wbar; aligned-factorized total mass zero; symmetric invariant to reversal while directed transposes. Empty/singleton/missing/unknown-action extras are zero. Equal positive gaps imply W=factorized=.5*M; weights unchanged by positive uniform time scaling or age translation. Tied rows have no inferred order.

Mechanism prediction: aligned_directed AUC exceeds factorized_directed if local-duration/action-pair association helps, exceeds aligned_symmetric if the added time-specific arrow helps, and the difference-in-differences (AD-FD)-(AS-FS) is positive if both interact. This is conditional support only until repeated across paired seeds.

Practical prediction: aligned_directed must exceed r0027-latest_endpoint and r0032-activity_ordered on full-population validation AUC to justify selection. Report Logloss and measured train/inference/memory costs even if rankings disagree. First512 diagnostics should show nonzero gap heterogeneity and alignment residual; they are descriptive and not population or label-based evidence.

Compare all host slices with sample/positive/negative counts; focus preregistered descriptive reading on history1_16,17_64,gt64 and cart/fav/buy present/absent. No unsupported per-gap performance or bootstrap claim because custom predictions/labels are unavailable. Existing generic slices remain exploratory after adaptive model search.
falsifiers: Absent/negligible gap variation or zero coupling residual means implementation cannot discriminate the proposed mechanism on observed support; check this before scientific interpretation.

AD<=FD weakens incremental utility of observed gap pairing; AD<=AS weakens need for directional coupling; nonpositive difference-in-differences weakens the interaction hypothesis. A win over incumbent without these contrasts establishes performance only.

No AUC improvement over incumbent after controlled/repeated comparison rejects selection for this implementation, not all duration-aware sequence models. Worse Logloss or measured cost can make an AUC gain unattractive.
Any nonfinite output, bound/mass/prefix/mask/direction failure invalidates comparison until repaired within charged budget. Scalar checks cannot establish Torch/CUDA correctness.
alternative_explanations: Single-seed SGD/checkpoint variation and selection over many prior rounds; no uncertainty interval or significance can be inferred from existing point estimates
Extra nonlinear interactions between pair rates and marginal gap heterogeneity alone; factorized control preserves these products
Added capacity/optimization paths and symmetric duplicate coordinate rank; identical parameter counts and retained directed parent address some but not all confounding
Gap weighting can track action-specific frequency, older timestamps or intensity rather than causal behavior progression; descriptive associations only
Coarse field collisions, hashed IDs, missing brand, truncated128-event windows, target>=2 support selection and undocumented snapshot dates limit generalization
The dimensionless weight discards absolute duration; failure may reflect that inductive bias rather than absence of useful temporal signal
